args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina Kroll, here's what I found for Kwame's account review. Sources: #coastal-team, #coastal-random, Moss's Coastal digests and your Pellucid cutover note.

*Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast)*
• #4419, open. The `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length. Source: Moss's Coastal cheat sheet. See the caveat below.
• PD-8841, ticket. Chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B). Raised by their night dispatcher Hector. Source: your 2025-12-08 cutover note. Status isn't stated.
• No ticket number: CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map. It was still lingering at the Nov 2025 cutover. Source: your cutover note.
• No ticket number: chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change, listed as the main friction point. Source: the cheat sheet. It may be the same issue as PD-8841, but nothing I read says so.

*Driftmoor Marine Freight (Puget Sound)*
• Feature request #882: a bulk-clear button for departed barges, asked for by their warehouse managers. Source: the cheat sheet.
• No ticket number: the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. Engineering supplied a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher. Source: the cheat sheet.
• No ticket number: Driftmoor asked for a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift. Source: Moss's 2025-11-02 digest. It is probably the same CSV patch as above, but that's my guess.

*Caveat on #4419:* the cheat sheet puts it on PHL, but Moss's 2025-11-02 digest describes it as Kwame's port account ticket about barge slip 7 schedule sync, in the Puget Sound / Driftmoor entry. I've listed it under PHL. Please check which account it belongs to before the review.

*Left out on purpose (Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark):* PD-4821 and #8812. I also skipped PD-4827 and PD-4824, which are Saltmarsh Provisions.

These are only the tickets mentioned in the channels and notes. I haven't checked any ticketing system, so the list may be incomplete. Most of it comes from undated or late-2025 notes, so statuses may be out of date.
